subject: one broad asymmetric arch with a generous open passage
idea: Stepping out of the workday into a small open space; the open passage is the first-read feature.
construction: One continuous heavy filled arch, broader left shoulder and a lower right terminal. Nearly rectangular outer width-to-height 1:1.1, but with one sweeping oblique roof curve, not a semicircular doorway. The open counter occupies about half the width, opens clearly to the bottom, and has a gentle rightward lean. Left and right strokes share smooth curvature transitions. The asymmetry is deliberate and calm. No detached piece or hairline cut.
material: Flat solid color with crisp edges; no gradients, texture, gloss or dimensional effects.
small_size: The bottom opening and unequal shoulder heights must survive 32px.
reference: Take deliberate contour asymmetry and silhouette-first construction from inspected Gentler Streak evidence; exclude its heart-like lobes, rear orange face, color and contours.
difference: A nonletter open organic passage, unlike a stacked Hangul glyph or a physical bench.
risk: Could become a generic arch or horseshoe; keep the oblique roof and distinct shoulder relationship without decorative cuts.
